name: renderer
body: Renderer: executes standard Go html/template layouts (no third-party engine) with pre-rendered content — body, `text` fields and each named section (rendered through its section template) passed as safe HTML; other fields as typed values (number/date formatted per `_format`, boolean, enum, list, image/link URLs) — and the registry's minimal function map (v1: `media`). Builds and passes the reserved deck/slide data context (template-context) — `deck` with the deck-wide title/author/date/properties and `slide` with the derived string position label `number` (number + letter for a vertical slide) and the integer `total` — into the slide layout and into every section instance's execution, at every composition depth; this context is data, not a helper. Layout execute errors become file:line-qualified templates errors. Applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode passed through from `navigation`), vertical stacks, anchors, notes.
